room_rent.note: Applies to both ₹3L and ₹5L SI. Proportionate deduction on associated medical expenses if higher room chosen; not applied on pharmacy, consumables, implants, diagnostics, ICU.

icu.note: ICU charges covered at actuals as part of inpatient treatment; no separate per-day cap stated for ICU room.

copayment.note: Mandatory 10% co-payment on every admissible claim amount, applicable to all insured persons regardless of age.

sub_limits.display: Cataract, bariatric, modern treatments, rehab, newborn, OPD, ambulance capped
sub_limits.note: Cataract: ₹25k (3L SI) / ₹35k (5L SI); Bariatric: ₹90k (3L) / ₹1.5L (5L); Modern treatments: various sub-limits (30% SI for some); Rehab & Pain Mgmt: ₹25k/yr; Newborn: 10% of mother's SI; OPD: ₹2k/₹3k per yr; Ambulance: ₹1,500/hosp, ₹3,000/yr; Home Care: 10% SI.

initial_waiting.note: Not applicable for accidents. Waived if continuously covered for more than 12 months.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months continuous coverage from first policy inception. Reduced by prior portability credit.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Covers cataract/eye diseases, ENT, thyroid, benign breast, hernia, varicose veins, joint/bone diseases, gallbladder/kidney stones, gynaec diseases, prostate, haemorrhoids, congenital internal defects, and more. Organ transplant: 36 months; Bariatric: 24 months; Newborn cover for mother: 12 months.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Code Excl 18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered. Newborn baby cover (up to 10% of mother's SI) is available after 12-month waiting period for the mother.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of SI added per claim-free year, max 50%. Reduced at same rate on a claim. Alternatively, insured may opt for No Claim Discount (4% on premium for ₹3L SI; 3% for ₹5L SI) instead — choice made at first purchase and maintained for lifetime.

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

day_care.display: All day-care procedures covered up to SI

domiciliary.note: Requires treatment >3 days. Excludes asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, epilepsy, hypertension, psychiatric disorders, arthritis, gout, and several other listed conditions.

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH hospitalisation covered up to SI. Yoga & Naturopathy requires prior company approval.

organ_donor.note: 36-month waiting period from first policy inception. Harvesting of donated organ included.

ambulance.note: Covers transport to hospital, hospital-to-hospital transfer, and return home (same city, if certified by doctor).

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgery for knee/hip replacement up to ₹4L or SI whichever less; other robotic procedures up to 30% SI or up to SI depending on type; immunotherapy, stem cell therapy, intravitreal injections, deep brain stimulation, balloon sinuplasty, oral chemotherapy, etc. — various sub-limits apply.

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-payable consumables (List I–IV) explicitly excluded from coverage.

global_cover.note: Territorial limit: all treatments must be taken in India (Condition 23).

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, no claim/policy contestable except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes. Coverage not available during grace period (except instalment policies).

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Apply at least 30 days before but not earlier than 60 days from renewal due date. Credits for PED, specific waiting periods, NCB, moratorium transferable.

notable_exclusions: Maternity, STDs (except HIV/AIDS), dental (unless accidental), congenital external defects, circumcision, erectile dysfunction, chelation/EECP/hyperbaric O2 therapies, PRP/chondrocyte injections, vaccination
optional_riders: No optional riders/add-ons mentioned in the policy wording
